Changes in 0.3.0:
- LIVE / WI-FI / HARDWARE bottom-page navigation.
- Signal trend charts now include grid lines, vertical scale labels and time axis.
- Antenna profiles: HT8 directional, Yagi U5 V3, telescopic GP, small loop.
- USB Host detection with VID/PID, CDC serial interface and permission state.
- USB device detection runs alongside the 2-second cellular refresh.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- TinySA serial protocol driver is still pending; USB detection is diagnostic only.
- NSA/SA NR band/frequency visibility depends on modem and OEM ROM.
